_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.154 (Ferals profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)

species.description: Quick and agile hunters with keen senses. Ferals prefer swift strikes and rely on speed over armor.

traits.name: Loping Run
traits.description: Ferals add +3" when Dashing instead of the normal +2.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: Ferals may add +1 to the final result of any Observation roll.
